stepTitle: Left: A unit square divided into $$4$$ vertical strips, with $$3$$ shaded blue (representing 3/4). Right: The same square with $$4$$ vertical strips with $$3$$ shaded blue, is further divided into $$3$$ horizontal rows. The region where the bottom $$2$$ rows overlap the three blue columns is shaded yellow (representing $$\frac{2}{3}$$ of the $$\frac{3}{4}$$ ).
choices: $$\frac{a}{b}=\frac{c}{d}$$ if and only if $$ad=bc$$, and $$b$$ and $$d$$ are nonzero
